tei:div.tei:p: de yang mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i gdul bya'i zhing spyir mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ sgos 'dzam bu'i gling khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ nye lam gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ bstan pa 'dzin cing gsal bar mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ bstan pa'i gtad rab bdun dang rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa brgyad cu la sogs pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba mang du mdzad cing khyad par gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/ chos rgyal mi dbon rnam gsum gyis chos kyi srol gtod pa nas paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba 'tsho dang*/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa paṇa grub dang*/ saṃ bho ṭa la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ sad mi bdun la sogs pa bstan pa snga dar gyi lo tsā dang dbus gtsang gi mi bcu la sogs pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi bstan 'dzin lo paṇa mkhas grub skar tshogs lta bu byon pa'i nang nas/ bla chen dpyal zhes pa mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa/ phyi'i mdzad pa dang nang gi rtogs pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral bas/ mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi cod pan du gyur pa'i mdzad spyod rgyun gyi 'jug ngogs 'di la/ sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan mtha' dag mnga' ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ sar gnas kyi skyes bus kyang brjod par dka' na gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa la sems can gyis blos dpag par dka' na'ang 'on kyang che long tsam zhig 'di ltar rtogs par bya/ dang por lha las babs pa'i rigs rus kyi che ba dang gcig /lha nas babs nas dpyal du grags te/ mtshan don gyi che ba dang gnyis/ ri bo rtse lngar byon nas rgya rgyal po dang gnyen du 'brel bas cho 'brang zhang dbon gyi che ba dang gsum/ de ltar lha las babs nas dpyal du grags/ bod rgyal po sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyi chos blon chen po mdzad pas na/ khrims gnyis mi dbon gyi che ba dang bzhi/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal gyis dpyal dkar nag khra gsum du lung bstan pas/

ngo mtshar lung bstan gyi che ba dang lnga/ gcen dge bshes rgyal po'i mchod gnas su bskur bas/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel khyad par 'phags pa'i che ba dang drug /de las kyang gsang sngags zab lam rdo rje theg par yang dag par zhugs pas/ rgyal po'i sku srung ba yin pas grub rtags nus mthu'i che ba dang bdun/ de las rim pa bzhin byon pa rnams kyis gtsang myang ro'i mthil du lha khang mang po bzhengs shing rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul la byon/ dka' ba brgya phrag du ma spyad nas paṇa grub tshad ldan bstain pa la gdams pa khyad par can zhus/ nyams len mthar phyin pa mdzad pas/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis che ba dang brgyad/ paṇa grub tshad ldan bstain pa rnams la mdo rgyud mang du zhus shing*/'gyur yang dag par mdzad nas/ chos mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa blangs shing dbang 'byor pas/ dam chos rang 'gyur gyi che ba dang dgu /mi mjed zhing du sems can chags pa nas/ mthar 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas na/ gdung rabs rgyun mi chad pa'i che ba'am bstan pa phyogs bcur gsal ba phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i che ba ste bcu'i sgo nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpyal gyi gdung rabs rim par byon pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa che ba bcu ldan zhes pa/ gdung rabs mgo sngon chen po 'di nyid sngon khams ston jo sras kyi mgo sngon tsam gyi bsdus pa zhig mdzad/ yang phyis su 'khon nam mkha' yangs pa'i shes rab kyi ral gris rang gi bla ma dpal rin chen pa'i bka' lung bzhin mgo sngaun chen po'i rtsom pa mdzad/ de'i rjes su 'jam dbyangs kyi rgyal pos dpyal kun dga' chos rgyal yan gyi rnam thar kha skong mdzad/ de'i rjes su ka pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis dpyal rdo rje rin chen pa yan gyi gdung rabs chen po rtsom pa mdzad pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i steng du/ khri thog zhal mnga' nas yab sras bzhugs pa'i dus thams cad glegs bam gcig tu dril ba ste 'grel 'dug

/'grel tshul yang dang po tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ de nas tshig lhug gi sgo nas rgyas par 'grel 'dug pa ma zad skabs babs kyi don rnams go bde la nges sla ba'i dgos pa khyad par can zhig tu snang*/ khyad chos de dag dang ldan pa'i gdung rabs 'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po ni bya bral ba pad ma rdo rje yin kyang*/ khong gi mdzad rnam cung zad tsam yang bdag gi mthong yul du ma gyur pas blo pham che/ phyag dpe'i 'di'i mjug tu u rgyan chos kyi dbang phyug de nyid dang*/ khyad par du/ gdung rgyud rin po che ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing gsung las skyes pa'i dus mtha'i bya btang ba pad+ma rdo rje zhes bya ba 'khod pa la dpag na/ dpyal ston rin chen rdo rje'i sras ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yin pa dang*/ khong gis paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa mchog dang*/ zha lu mkhan chen dkon mchog tshul khrims dang*/ mkhan chen dkon mchog lhun grub sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang*/ ngag dbang grags pa lhun grub kyi dngos slob bya btang ba pad+ma rdo rje yin pa bcas kyis/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang du byung ba'i mkhas dbang zhig yin/ khong gis grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma rnams kyi drung du mdo rgyud rgya mtsho lta bu la slob gnyer mthar phyin pa gnang ba dang*/ khyad par gsang sngags rnying ma la thugs gzhol bar mdzad/ rin po che'i ming can gyi bskul ngor byang chub thar pa gling du me pho rta'i lo la 'go brtsams nas zhes brtsams lo gsal bar 'khod yod/ skyes chen dam pa de rnams kyis/ grub mtha' ris su ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs nas/ mdo rgyud kyi chos rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan bzhed gnang bas/

dang ba 'gro ba dang*/ gdung rabs kyang de nyid dang 'brel bas/ lo rgyus kyi khyab khongs che ba sogs kyi dgos pa mang po yod/ 'on kyang gdung rabs 'di'i ma dpe ni/ bris ma yin pa dang*/ skung yig mang ba dang*/ yig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ brda rnying gis brgyan pa bcas kyis zhus dag byed par 'gal rkyen mi nyung ba zhig 'phrad kyang*/ dang du blangs nas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams la gzigs bde yong ba'i ched/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung dang bstun nas/ zhus dag par bgyis khul yin kyang ma dag pa'i cha yong nges pas/ lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi mkhas dbang rnams dang*/ gzur gnas blo ldan rnams kyis dgongs 'char gang mang yong ba'i re 'dun dang bcas/ nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs kyi ¡¶ deb bzhi par ¡· btang nas par skrun zhus pa lags/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi bstan 'dzin blo gros pas/ bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ -PAGE 4--PAGE 5--PAGE 1-
